title: Fed’s Barr invokes Panic of 1907 in warning on stablecoin rules
summary: US Fed Governor Michael Barr said clearer US rules could help the market grow, but warned that GENIUS Act implementation must still guard against runs, weak reserves and illicit finance.

title: US crypto wash trading case reaches court as 3 extradited, 10 charged
summary: Extraditions of executives from market makers Vortex, Contrarian, Gotbit and Antier mark the latest step in a multi‑agency effort targeting alleged “market‑manipulation‑as‑a‑service.”

title: Bitcoin ETFs post $1.3B in March inflows, first monthly gain of 2026
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs ended Q1 in the red, with about $500 million of net outflows despite March inflows, as sentiment remained weak amid geopolitical tensions.

title: Bitcoin’s drawdown is ‘less dramatic’ this cycle, Fidelity says
summary: A shallower Bitcoin drawdown than previous cycles "indicates a maturing market with reduced volatility and stronger institutional confidence," said Nick Ruck, director of LVRG Research.

title: Dorsey shares AI-integrated workplace vision weeks after Block’s 40% staff cut
summary: Block cut 4,000 of its staff in February as part of its AI-driven pivot. A new post by Block's Jack Dorsey has shed light on how the company and others might operate in the future.

title: CFTC’s top enforcer puts prediction market insider traders on notice
summary: “There’s a myth in mainstream media and social media that insider trading doesn’t apply in the prediction markets … That is wrong,” said CFTC enforcement director David Miller.

title: E-commerce giant Mercado Libre to sunset rewards-based Mercado Coin: Report
summary: The closure of Mercado Coin doesn't mark the end of Mercado Libre's crypto rewards strategy as it still offers the Meli Dolar (MUSD), a US dollar stablecoin which launched in 2024.

title: New Hampshire’s Bitcoin-backed bond gets Moody's rating
summary: Moody's assigned a provisional Ba2 rating to New Hampshire’s bond project, placing it below investment grade, as it cited Bitcoin’s volatility.

title: Researchers say quantum computers could, in theory, be ready by 2030
summary: New research from Caltech and Oratomic, a Caltech-linked startup, says quantum computers of the future may be closer to reality.

title: Bitfarms loss widened to $285M as Bitcoin fell, but shares jump anyway
summary: Bitfarms said it was impacted by a decline in Bitcoin prices last year. The company is now five months into its pivot from Bitcoin mining to HPC and AI.
